Arabic-STT run 3: full fine-tune, weights gated on the Hub; trained on the train splits of CV18 and MASC and on MGB-2/SADA/MGB-3 train rows (rows overlapping their test sets excluded). Its kejue-common-voice stream also holds 20 FLEURS ar_eg *test* sentences (37 of our 428 fleurs_ar rows), which the contamination guard did not cover; labels of that stream come from Soniox stt-async-v5

Arabic-STT run 5: run 3 continued twice (runs 4 and 5) with more call, dialect and code-switching data; same in-domain train rows as run 3, including MGB-3 train and the 20 leaked FLEURS ar_eg test sentences; also trained on clips of the lahgtna-v3-small test split
Arabic-STT run5base: run 5's data and targets trained from the base model (40,000 steps); same in-domain train rows as run 5, including MGB-3 train and the 20 leaked FLEURS ar_eg test sentences
